## Verification

- [ ] Ran the verification listed for the OpenSpec task.
- [ ] Checked `git status --short` before staging.
- [ ] Confirmed staged files are inside the task write scope.

## Commit Safety

- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Commits are signed when local signing is configured.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, signing keys, certificates, or build artifacts are staged.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes list the relevant guardrail or review note.
